add_layer_to_parameter: add a casting layer to a nevergrad parameter using add_layer method
cast_array_to_scalar: cast a size-1 numpy array parameter to a scalar float using _ScalarCasting layer
cast_list_to_array: cast a tuple or list input to a numpy array using ArrayCasting layer
apply_integer_casting: apply deterministic or non-deterministic integer casting to a nevergrad data parameter using Int layer
filter_layered_classes: filter layers from a parameter by class type using Filterable.filter_from class method
